inventory.notes: Support for Juggler's caller world only (the hybridXrays sandbox option, which only Juggler passes); the page-visible effect lives in WrapperFactory.cpp (spoof). Movable parts: the hybridXrays validation (about 7 lines) and the locale block (about 8 lines). The locale block reimplements the primary-tag step (FindChar, Truncate, Trim) instead of calling intl::PrimaryLanguageTag, which BrowsingContext.cpp already uses and which is declared in intl/locale/StealthSessionPrefs.h. Two copies of the same rule can diverge; it should call the helper. Feature field is hybrid-xrays; the locale part is timezone-locale-override. Hunk map: hybrid-xrays = hunks 1 (include), 2 (getPropertyDescriptorImpl), 3 (CreateSandboxObject validation), 5-6 (compartment flag assert and set), 7 (Parse); timezone-locale-override = hunk 4 (locale primary-tag block, about 8 lines). Verified: only Juggler passes hybridXrays (juggler/content/FrameTree.js:753); the duplicated primary-tag block versus intl::PrimaryLanguageTag (intl/locale/StealthSessionPrefs.cpp:41-48) is confirmed identical in behaviour.
